evals.name: round-trip-generated-message
evals.prompt: Verify the Python consumer can serialize ParcelCollected's event type metadata and resolve a stub.
evals.expected_output: Native generated-message round-trip without a kernel.
assertions: Uses the generated EventTypes package modules and their actual field casing.
Checks the decoded ID and generation and resolves the gRPC stub.
Does not present serialization as append evidence.

evals.name: compare-native-defaults
evals.prompt: Can Kotlin enforce the same default expected position as TypeScript because they share a protobuf?
assertions: Names an expected-position prerequisite rather than relying on schema presence.
Separates wire compatibility from append defaults.
Requires checking native operation and scope policy per SDK.

evals.name: route-arc-endpoint
evals.prompt: We need a Python Arc query endpoint, not a Chronicle contract consumer. Route the request.
assertions: Distinguishes a business query from a gRPC service stub.
Does not invent a Python Chronicle high-level method to implement an Arc endpoint.
